summary: A prompt-independent string-frequency shortcut solves 36/36 delivered cases across five easy templates and 4/5 runner questions. Source replay, mathematics, grading, rendering, and packaging pass. Package unchanged; no database writes.

source_analysis.skill: Convert a first-order linear ODE to dy/dx + P(x)y = Q(x), preserving algebraic equivalence.
reasoning_steps: Collect dependent-variable terms and forcing terms.
Cancel permitted factors and normalize the derivative coefficient.
Simplify coefficients and select the equivalent standard-form equation.
invariants: First derivative only; no integration or solving.
P and Q depend only on x.
Preserve domain restrictions and a unique correct radio choice.
permitted_variations: Change supported coefficients, signs, and function parameters while preserving workload.
Vary eligible answer-bearing assignments and option positions.

decision_variation.details: Controlled dependencies pass, but literal side repetition predicts every key in five delivered template groups. The defect survives filtering. None of the four captured generated inventory records demonstrates this specific weakness.

findings.description: Split each option at '=' and score it by frequency(left side) + frequency(right side). Selecting the unique maximum requires no prompt reading or algebra, yet succeeds on 56/56 raw and 36/36 delivered observations within q-16400, q-103354, q-16396, q-79697, and q-79699. It solves 4/5 runner questions. Tested moderate samples also exhibit this cue.
